name: comparison_operators
comment: Pins the exact operator tokens (<> > < <=), the explicit 'and' node, and case-insensitive property resolution ('email' finds Email).

sqlite.sql: select id, name, email, display_name, created_at, updated_at from users where (email <> @c0 and id > @c1 and id < @c2 and id <= @c3)

sqlserver.sql: select [id], [name], [email], [display_name], [created_at], [updated_at] from [users] where ([email] <> @c0 and [id] > @c1 and [id] < @c2 and [id] <= @c3)
